_docs: The hypothesis register — docs/north-star-metric-lock.md (LOCKED 2026-09-18). Declared, not derived: which artifact is authoritative for a retired class is a governance choice (for H1 the newest backtest artifact only agrees with the locked label because Phase 4b re-labelled it), so a row lives here and can only disappear via a reviewed diff. `north-star` derives the LIVE readings only, and checks every `artifact*` field below against the file it names. Fields: `state` is live|retired; `clock` is gating|accruing-only for live rows (an accruing-only row keeps accruing but cannot gate anything — K-lock D3 — so it is excluded from L2's completion and from the project-level date); `artifactClassLocator` is a locator like `lanes[].verdict` evaluated against the artifact, and every located value must equal `artifactClass`; when a retired row's governing `class` differs from `artifactClass` a `divergenceReason` is required, and when the artifact carries no class at all the row is MAPPED and also needs a reason.

hypotheses.title: the shipped screen, on the picker window
hypotheses.statistic: mean 20d rank IC with Newey-West t (lag 20)
hypotheses.note: The PRE-REGISTERED verdict lives in 2026-09-10.json (h1_revised on both lanes) and stays the reference; Phase 4b re-labelled it to insufficient_evidence because each lane's detection floor (US 0.0298, HK 0.0493) exceeds the bar's own 0.02 magnitude, so a FAIL cannot falsify the effect. The re-labelling is recorded in 2026-09-10.ANNOTATION.md, and 2026-09-11/13 carry the relabelled field. Retired by K1 on 2026-09-18.

hypotheses.title: the screen against the vendor archive (H1 generality), design half
hypotheses.statistic: mean 20d rank IC with Newey-West t (lag 20), as-traded bars + split registry
hypotheses.window: design half 2022-09-01…2024-08-30 (502 sessions); test half 2024-09-03 onward, UNSPENT
hypotheses.bar: 2.4865 × design-half NW SE, capped at 0.03 → 0.0486; declared underpowered by design BEFORE any test-half number existed
hypotheses.divergenceReason: The artifact's `verdict` field is computed against Phase 4's 0.02 magnitude bar — its own note says the lane can only detect IC ≥ 0.0391 at t = 2, which is ABOVE that bar, so it reports insufficient_evidence. The class that governs this lane is Phase 4c's design-half power determination: 2.4865 × 0.019558 = 0.0486, above the 0.03 cap, declared before the test half was touched. The 0.02-bar field is superseded for this lane. DIVERGENT on purpose — the divergence is a reviewed fact, not a silent override.
hypotheses.note: Retired by K1 on 2026-09-18. The test half remains unspent and that is not an extension: spending it cannot add information the design already lacks.

hypotheses.title: borrowed formulaic cross-sectional alphas, picker window
hypotheses.statistic: mean 20d rank IC with Newey-West t, BH FDR at q = 0.05 across the swept set
hypotheses.bar: |mean 20d IC| ≥ the lane's power floor (US 0.0297 · HK 0.0493) AND a BH-FDR survivor
hypotheses.divergenceReason: The artifact carries per-alpha LABELS (alive/reversed/dead), not a five-class verdict — the sweep's own vocabulary. The mapping to insufficient_evidence is by hand and named here rather than derived: every US row is `dead`, and `dead` is defined as UNINFORMATIVE (not FDR survivor, or |IC| below the lane's floor), which is what insufficient_evidence means. The evidence: 0 of 436 US rows survive FDR, the US promotion list is empty, and no US alpha reaches its own luck benchmark (max ratio 0.78). Recorded the way the §5.3 audit mapped H2's outputs onto the five classes.
hypotheses.note: Retired by K1's extended scope on 2026-09-18. A7 is BLOCKED: the pre-registered promotion rule needs a non-empty FDR-surviving set, and the set is empty, so the vendor test half cannot be spent. HK produced 30 survivors on the 27-name U2 cross-section — recorded, and none of it is evidence: the same 166 alphas gave opposite signs in US, and HK can never exceed insufficient_evidence in this phase.

hypotheses.title: the LLM deep-dive layer's conviction as a signal
hypotheses.statistic: IC | rank (decides; raw IC reported alongside, 0.32 rank-correlated with it)
hypotheses.universe: deep-dive verdicts, pooled across both lanes
hypotheses.window: prospective from 2026-09-12; the k3-256k sub-sample is EXCLUDED (model stack re-baselined to deepseek-flash ×3 on 2026-09-16)
hypotheses.bar: readiness: SE(mean IC) ≤ IC_target / POWER_Z = 0.10 / 2.4865 = 0.0402, and only a MEASURED SE may authorise a decision
hypotheses.note: The only live gating hypothesis, and therefore the project-level reading. Its numbers are recomputed from the store on every run (`verdict:validate`), so no artifact pointer is declared — a dated file would go stale and a pointer to it would be provenance theatre. The scheduled artifact is the weekly digest (logs/validation-digest-<date>.json) and this readout writes reports/north-star-<date>.json. 1.5x SE-stability guard (K-lock D5b: two consecutive weekly digests) is the only path to K2 short of outright falsification. K4 fires if readiness is not reached by 2027-06-30.

hypotheses.title: the screen's prospective differential vs its own equal-weight benchmark
hypotheses.statistic: NW t on the daily arithmetic differential (Phase 4b D6's statistic)
hypotheses.bar: NW t ≥ 2 on the differential at its observed information ratio
hypotheses.note: Recorded as NOT a clock (K-lock D3): the rank-IC path needs 4.7 y (US) / 18.1 y (HK) and the differential ~7 y at the observed IR, so it may keep accruing but cannot gate anything. Excluded from L2's completion and from the project-level date — including it would make L2 unreachable by construction. The artifact pointer is the backtest artifact its SE projection comes from, which is why it is provenance-only: no class is expected from it.
